item.title: Pet Care
item.content:encoded:
Want more takers for your pet care services? Promote your services online by building an attractive website using the Pet Care template. It comes with everything you need to take your business online and engage with prospective pet lovers.

The homepage is designed to promote your best three services right up front. Scroll down, and you get to showcase all your services, include reviews of happy pet lovers, and book a free consultation call.

Key features of the Pet Care template

  • Creatively designed pet care website template
  • Impressive mouseover effects on the homepage images
  • Done-for-you templates for about us, services, reviews, and contact page
  • The about us page includes details of the team behind the pet care service
  • SEO-friendly and page builder ready
item.excerpt:encoded: A perfect website template to connect with pet lovers and offer your pet care services

item.title: Online Furniture Store
item.content:encoded:
The right furniture livens up your home. It sets the ​​stage for comfortable and cozy living spaces. And what better way to set the tone online than having the perfect website template. 

The Online Furniture Store template is beautifully designed, helping you create an instant engagement with your customers. The template is designed to help you sell all kinds of furniture for living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and bathrooms.

Key features of the Online Furniture Store template

  • Beautifully designed website template
  • Showcase your latest products and best sellers on the homepage
  • Offers deals and offers on the homepage
  • Build an email list by getting customers to sign up for your newsletter
  • SEO-friendly and WooCommerce-ready template
item.excerpt:encoded: Well designed eCommerce web template to sell all kinds of home decor

item.title: Moving Services
item.content:encoded:
The Moving Services template delivers a bright welcome as soon as it loads. The homepage has a fullscreen header with bright colors, an engaging image and bold headline to make an instant impact.

The rest of the template backs up that impact with vibrant colors, plenty of whitespace, modern fonts and lots of content areas to share your products, services and essential information. There’s also a simple contact form, ready for engagement!

Key features of the Moving Services template

  • Impactful fullscreen header with bold image and colors
  • Bright and welcoming design draws you in

item.title: Dentist Clinic
item.content:encoded:
The Dentist Clinic website template is a clean, modern design with reassuring colors and fonts and a contact form front and center. The blue and green are classic medical colors and combine well with the white.

The rest of the design provides areas to tell your story, outline products and services and patient testimonials. There are also attractive calls to action throughout, everything you need to build a website for a practice.

Key features of the Dentist Clinic template

  • Uses colors we automatically relate to medicine
  • Excellent layout with lots of content areas and whitespace
  • Includes common content areas a dentist would require
  • Attractive calls to action throughout
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Well-designed template ideal for dentists, clinics and medical practices

item.title: A/C Technician
item.content:encoded:
The A/C Technician template is a business-like design with a bold homepage and an illustrative image in the hero section. Combined with a direct call to action in the schedule button, it accomplishes its core goal immediately.

The rest of the template offers opportunities to outline products and services, areas of specialization and testimonials. All things a contractor, trade or business website needs to convert visitors into new customers.

Key features of the A/C Technician template

  • Simple, effective website design ideal for the trades
  • Effective hero image with call to action
  • Customizable content areas for extra content
  • Attractive contact form
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Effective small business website for tradespeople or service businesses

item.title: Halloween Shop
item.content:encoded:
Step into the world of enchantment with our Halloween Shop template! Crafted to give your store a spooktacular makeover, this fully responsive template is your key to success.

The design is wickedly delightful, capturing the essence of Halloween and creating an immersive experience for your customers. Navigating through your eerie products and seasonal specials is a breeze, thanks to the user-friendly features that make online shopping a joy.

Key features of the Halloween Shop Template:

  • Wicked shop design ideal for Halloween
  • User-friendly and built for online stores
  • Fast and fully responsive
  • Professional quality designs
  • Full compatibility with popular page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Elevate your Halloween shop with our spellbinding website template!

item.title: Halloween
item.content:encoded:
Get ready to enchant your online visitors with our exclusive Halloween Event website template! It's not just a template; it's your secret weapon to make your website as hauntingly stylish as Halloween itself.

Don't let slow-loading pages give your visitors a fright – our template ensures a fast and seamless experience, keeping them hooked on your bewitching content. Fast, fully responsive, fully customizable and ready to engage.

Key features of the Halloween Template:

  • Haunting design for Halloween
  • User-friendly and very easy to use
  • Fast performance with plenty of options
  • Professional quality design ready to represent your brand
  • Full compatibility with popular page builders

item.title: Painter
item.content:encoded:
The Painter template is a bright, engaging design that opens with a large header, handwritten and modern fonts and lots of bright images. It’s a very creative web template that fits the artist and painter niche perfectly.

The template includes alternating colored and light backgrounds with textured images, bright contrast colors and flowing layout. Complementary pages all reflect the core design, with different colors to indicate different purposes while looking and feeling similar.

Key features of the Painter template

  • Bright, colorful design perfect for painters and artists
  • Flowing layout that encourages you to explore
  • Strong images to help showcase your work
  • Extra pages including a portfolio
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Colorful website template for artists, creatives and painters to show their work

item.title: Hope
item.content:encoded:
Unleash the power of exceptional design with the Hope template for web designers! Crafted for creative professionals, this template ensures your website is not just a platform but a masterpiece.

The sleek and intuitive design allows you to showcase your portfolio effortlessly, creating a lasting impression on visitors. Elevate your brand with a professional-quality website that speaks volumes about your design expertise.

Key features of the Hope Template:

  • Sleek design to show your skills
  • Easy customization thanks to built-in Site Builder
  • Designed for speed and usability
  • Professional-quality template designed for the niche
  • Full compatibility with popular page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Transform your online presence with our sleek web designer template!

item.title: Webinar
item.content:encoded:
The Webinar template is a light and welcoming landing page ideal for seminars, webinars and other types of presentation or meeting. It’s a light, modern design with the who, what, when and where above the fold and space for everything else beneath. 

The page uses a reassuring blue color but can be customized with any color, font and layout. It’s fully responsive and compatible with leading page builders, so you can personalize the Webinar template however you like. It’s a well-designed theme ideal for many types of landing pages!

Key features of the Webinar template

  • Well-designed webinar landing page template
  • Modern design with lots of whitespace
  • Can be fully customized to suit any brand
  • Key information is all above the fold
  • Fully compatible with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Modern Webinar landing page template with all the characteristics you need

item.title: Freelance Copywriter
item.content:encoded:
The Freelance Copywriter template works as a business website or online resume depending on how you configure it. It’s a relaxed design with lots of white space and calm complementing colors.

The design includes plenty of opportunities to highlight skills and experience as well as products and services. There’s an engaging call to action, milestone and awards section, a portfolio page, testimonials page and an attractive contact page. Everything the budding freelancer needs to grow their business.

Key features of the Freelance Copywriter template

  • Configurable resume or business website for freelancers
  • Easygoing design with calm colors and whitespace
  • Lots of customizable content areas
  • Portfolio page already designed and ready to go
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Adaptable web template ideal for freelancer and small business promotion

item.title: Party Planner
item.content:encoded:
Step into the world of seamless celebrations with our Party Planner website template. Crafted with stylish design ideal for the niche, this template sets the stage for unforgettable events, ideal for startups, small events businesses or party planners.

The professional-quality design adds a touch of elegance to your online presence, making your party planning services stand out. Elevate your business with ease and let the festivities begin with our exquisite template!

Key Features of the Part Planner Template:

  • Stylish design ideal for events and party planners
  • Infinitely customizable using built-in tools
  • Easy to use and requires no existing skills
  • Fully responsive and SEO friendly
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Elevate your party planning with our stylish website template.

item.title: Charity
item.content:encoded:
The Charity template has a warm, welcoming appeal that oozes positivity. It’s ideal for nonprofits or charities as it creates the urge to share in your good work and encourages visitors to engage.

The bold colors, emotive imagery and mix of handwritten and standard fonts keeps things approachable while the mixture of dark, light and colorful sections keeps the reader engaged without overloading them. All while encouraging giving.

Key features of the Charity template

  • Welcome feel with instant connection
  • Mix of dark, light and color works well
  • Lots of space for imagery and storytelling
  • Calls to action and donation throughout
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Appealing design with vibrant colors and positivity ideal for charities and nonprofits

item.title: Simply Natural
item.content:encoded:
If you are looking for a simple and clean website design to sell all kinds of plants online, Simply Natural is just the template for you. The minimalist design has all the elements to build a highly engaging online store.

From an impressive hero section that includes a CTA button to the featured products and client testimonials, the template has all the ingredients you need to build a fantastic online store.

Key features of the Simply Natural template

  • Simple, clean, and elegant design, ideal for selling plants online
  • Showcase your featured products as well as the latest arrivals
  • Easily customize every element of your website to suit your specific requirements
  • Fully responsive and WooCommerce-ready template
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders

item.title: Home and Garden Decor
item.content:encoded:
The Home & Garden Décor template has a flat, modern feel with lots of whitespace, great colors and lots of opportunities to build a high conversion online store. The content blocks deliver lots of opportunities to showcase products, special offers and calls to action.

The fully responsive template also includes attractive product pages, an effective cart page and a frictionless checkout page ready to sell. It looks amazing as it is but you can change everything you see using free tools.

Key features of the Home & Garden Décor template

  • Elegant eCommerce store template for home or garden
  • Calm colors and welcoming layout
  • Effective product, cart and checkout pages
  • Customize everything you see on the page
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Transform your living space into a sanctuary with our curated collection of exquisite home decor.

item.title: Black Friday
item.content:encoded:
Are you ready to take your Black Friday sales to the next level? Don't miss out on the opportunity to transform your online presence and boost your business. Dive into the magic of our exclusive, fully responsive Black Friday Cyber Monday web template!

With its sleek design and user-friendly interface, this template is crafted to make your online store shine. Say goodbye to slow load times as the template ensures lightning-fast performance, keeping your customers engaged and ready to shop till they drop.

Key Features of Black Friday

  • Sleek design with Black Friday Cyber Monday theme
  • User-friendly and very easy to use
  • Lightning-fast performance thanks to optimized code
  • Fully responsive and SEO friendly
  • Full compatibility with popular page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Boost sales on Black Friday with a user-friendly web template!

item.title: Bestselling Author
item.content:encoded:
As an author, you’ll surely want your publication to be the next bestseller. Want to promote your books online? Build a stylish and creative website using the Bestselling Author template and launch your website right away.

The template is smartly designed and well planned, from promoting your latest book upfront to showcasing all your work on the homepage. The readymade templates include pages like about, books, and contact.

Key features of the Bestselling Author template

  • Build your website using the stylish Bestselling Author template
  • Promote your latest book on the homepage, above the fold
  • The template is WooCommerce ready and allows you to sell your books online
  • A fully functional contact form for readers to connect with you
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Stylish website template for authors to promote and sell their publications

item.title: Visual Artist Portfolio
item.content:encoded:
The Visual Artist Portfolio template uses minimalist design to let your work speak for itself. It’s a well-balanced portfolio template that provides an attractive framework to show off your work, engage visitors and attract new clients.

The template includes an attractive frameless portfolio section, biography section, an area for testimonials and a contact form. There’s also a great-looking dedicated portfolio page where you can share all your best work for the world to see.

Key features of the Visual Artist Portfolio template

  • Minimalist design that’s clean and modern
  • Provides the framework to let your work shine through
  • Lots of whitespace so images really stand out
  • Includes all portfolio essentials
  • Fully compatible with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: The Visual Artist Portfolio template is a minimalist design with just enough to engage while allowing your work to shine through. It’s the perfect balance!

item.title: Digital Download Store
item.content:encoded:
The Digital Download Store template is a crisp, clean design with engaging colors and images and all the ingredients an online store needs. It has a compelling hero section with call to action, trust signals above the fold and lots of space to showcase your products.

Product pages are simple and attractive, designed to let the product shine and convert customers. Cart pages, the checkout page, contact form and all supplementary pages reflect the clean design with minimum distractions.

Key features of the Digital Download Store template

  • Clean modern design for eCommerce stores
  • Supports digital downloads and physical products
  • Attractive product pages
  • Exceptional customer journey throughout the store
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: The Digital Download Store template is a high performance design for eCommerce stores.

item.title: Music School
item.content:encoded:
The Music School Template is an easy-to-use website template that can be customized to sell musical instruments, offer music lessons, and showcase your school's campus. Use it as a starting point for your website by adding your content and photos of the music teachers.

The template is not only designed for musicians but also offers a great option for people who want to learn how to play an instrument.

Key features of the Music School template

  • Build a music school website using our inspiring Music School template
  • Accept online applications of prospective students
  • A fully compatible template that allows you to offer and manage online courses
  • Sell musical instruments online using a WooCommerce-ready template
  • Customizable and page-ready template
item.excerpt:encoded: Perfect template for any aspiring musician to offer courses and sell musical instruments

item.title: Financial Advisors
item.content:encoded:
The Financial Advisors template has the gravity and authority clients look for in the financial niche. All without being too overbearing or too sensible. It’s a modern, light design with lots of images and bold contrast colors.

The entire template has been designed with finance in mind. That means balancing the modern with the established to create confidence in visitors. We think this template delivers that and so much more!

Key features of the Financial Advisors template

  • Light, modern design with the required gravity for finance
  • Flexible content areas throughout
  • Customizable colors and fonts
  • Readymade service and contact pages
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Modern website design that’s ideal for the finance industry and financial advisers

item.title: University
item.content:encoded:
The University template opens with an emotive success image that sets the scene. Combined with a central menu and simple header, it achieves a lot with very little. The homepage is largely grayscale but uses color for graphics buttons and images to help them stand out.

The rest of the template is fully customizable with flexible content areas, dedicated course and teacher pages and the opportunity to move, add or change anything you see on the page.

Key features of the University template

  • Makes an impact as soon as the homepage loads
  • Combines grayscale and color for maximum impact
  • Additional course and teacher pages
  • Customize everything you see on the page
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Well-designed template ideal for schools, colleges and educational institutions

item.title: Christmas Shop
item.content:encoded:
Spread the cheer online with our Christmas Shop web template. Dress your online store in holiday splendor with our Christmas Shop web template. The design captures the festive spirit, ensuring your products shine as bright as Rudolph's nose.

Managing your online Christmas shop has never been this easy. The template is fast, fully responsive, SEO friendly and has all you need to sell online. Let the sleigh bells ring and the orders jingle with a website as delightful as the season it celebrates!

Key features of the Christmas Shop Template:

  • Festive design for Christmas stores
  • Fully supports SureCart and WooCommerce
  • Vibrant and engaging page sections
  • Fully customizable and SEO friendly
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Unwrap the joy with our festive Christmas shop template

item.title: Digital Product Store
item.content:encoded:
The Digital Product Store website template is a contemporary eCommerce design designed to convert using calm colors, simple design and effective typography. It’s a relaxed design with frameless sections and a centralized product area to showcase your wares.

The Digital Product Store template includes highlighted product areas, icon-driven navigation, testimonials, subscription option and attractive supplementary pages. The entire design can be fully customized to suit any products or type of store.

Key features of the Digital Product Store template

  • Contemporary Digital Product website design
  • Calm design with engaging elements designed to convert
  • Lots of product showcase options
  • Can be fully customized for any type of online store
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Contemporary digital product store template that engages right away

item.title: Deeplight Restaurant
item.content:encoded:
The Deeplight Restaurant template is a cool, contemporary design with a full screen image, central navigation and a subtle arrow directing you down. Further down the homepage, things lighten up with a white background and lots of image options.

The design includes lots of options for content, a menu section, testimonials, booking option and contact details. Everything a food business would want from a page. There are also relevant extra pages suitable for the niche.

Key features of the Deeplight Restaurant template

  • Contemporary design with modern touches throughout
  • Sections for menus, images and testimonials
  • Subtle graphic encourages you to scroll down
  • Extra pages relevant to food businesses
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Contemporary website template ideal for cafes, restaurants and food businesses

item.title: Learn Oil Painting
item.content:encoded:
The Learn Oil Painting template is built ready for eLearning. While art is the subject here, it could easily be customized to suit any niche. It’s an informative website with great colors, a mix of elegant fonts and some powerful imagery.

The template includes an attractive block effect with lots of space for content and images. It has areas to outline courses, attractive course pages, a testimonials section and a selection of supplementary pages ideal for eLearning.

Key features of the Learn Oil Painting template

  • Informative design ideal for eLearning
  • Great use of colors and fonts
  • Course pages already made
  • Flexible content areas throughout
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Informative web template for online courses or eLearning businesses

item.title: Language Tutors
item.content:encoded:
The Language Tutor template has a smart, crisp look, with a large hero section and muted colors with a bold contrast color. It looks professional and is designed to help you showcase your language skills or promote a language school.

The template features a natural color palette with pops of green and blue, which will be sure to make your website feel like a tranquil escape. The template has been carefully crafted to exhibit your services in the most elegant way possible.

Key features of the Language Tutor template

  • Inspired and inspiring website template
  • Muted color palette with bold contrast color
  • Includes all elements a typical language tutor needs
  • Fully responsive and SEO friendly
  • Compatible with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Language Tutor template to help you share your knowledge with ease

item.title: Clothing Store
item.content:encoded:
The Clothing Store template is an achingly stylish eCommerce template designed for modern retail. It opens with a full screen hero image with subtle navigation and cart feature at the top and opens into a smart store page with parallax effect.

The fully customizable template can be made to fit any brand or store type using built-in tools. You can change anything you like in seconds. The template is fully compatible with popular page builders so anyone, with any level of experience can craft something unique!

Key features of the Clothing Store template

  • Stylish modern store design
  • Engaging parallax effect on the homepage
  • Attractive product and checkout pages
  • SEO friendly and fully responsive
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders

item.title: Galatic
item.content:encoded:
The Galatic template could be the perfect foundation for your next business website. It has all the ingredients we look for in a site, speed, flexibility, customization, page builder compatibility, SEO-friendliness and full responsiveness. All wrapped up in an attractive package.

The template has a classic small business layout that can be fully customized to suit your unique needs using built-in tools. Pages load fast and support content, images, video, eCommerce, learning and anything else you could think of!

Key features of the Web Developer Portfolio template

  • Modern business template with tons of features
  • Change anything and everything to suit your needs
  • Delivers an awesome user experience
  • SEO friendly and fully responsive
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders

item.title: Gym Pro
item.content:encoded:
The Gym Pro template is a fantastic example of high energy design focused for a niche. Created for gyms and fitness, it reflects the industry perfectly with strong colors, bold images and that green contrast color.

Everything can be customized to suit your taste or your brand. The Gym Pro template is fully compatible with drag and drop page builders where you can customize everything you see on the page. The template is also fully responsive and will look just as amazing on small screens.

Key features of the Gym Pro template

  • High energy template for gyms and fitness
  • Great use of color and images throughout
  • Fully responsive and works seamlessly on mobile
  • Can be fully customized from the header to the footer
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: The Gym Pro template uses high energy design to set the scene perfectly

item.title: Generic
item.content:encoded:
The Generic Template is a foundational template, ideal for customizing to create something uniquely suited to your business. The default design has all the features businesses look for along with the option to customize everything you see on the page.

The template is fully compatible with popular page builders, supports images, video and rich media and loads impressively fast. It’s also fully responsive, SEO-friendly and compatible with all compliant WordPress plugins. What more could you need from a business website template?

Key features of the Generic template

  • Foundational template ideal for any type of business
  • Flexible content blocks and layouts
  • Customize everything you see on the page
  • SEO friendly and fully responsive

item.title: CeramicShop
item.content:encoded:
The Ceramic Shop template could work as a business website or online store. The design uses calm colors and typography to set the scene perfectly. Quality images and content placement inspires confidence while subtly converting visitors.

The default design is exceptional but can be customized however you like. Use built-in tools, your favorite page builder or the WordPress editor to turn this into something truly unique. All without losing that special something that helps it stand out from the crowd.

Key features of the CeramicShop template

  • Calm colors and typography throughout
  • Supports eCommerce with included store elements
  • Fully customizable so you can make any type of store
  • SEO friendly and fully responsive
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: The Ceramic Shop template for eCommerce stores and creative businesses

item.title: David Williams
item.content:encoded:
The Freelance Trader template design creates a professional feel to help build trust and engage new clients. While perfect for traders, financiers and financial businesses, it’s flexible enough to be transformed into any type of site you can think of.

The template uses strong images with a slick parallax effect. It has customizable content blocks where you can add or remove content, change colors, fonts and anything about the page. It’s very easy to use thanks to full compatibility with leading page builders!

Key features of the David Williams template

  • Professional quality small business or freelancer template
  • Modern flat layout with smart color choices
  • Fast and very easy to use
  • SEO friendly and fully responsive
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Freelance Trader template designed to engage and impress clients

item.title: Dentalist
item.content:encoded:
The Dentalist template is a clean, crisp design created to inspire trust and attract new clients. It uses bright colors, a logical layout and creates an engaging customer journey throughout. It’s fast, flexible and could be tweaked for any type of business.

The template has been created for dentists, but thanks to built-in tools and page builder compatibility, you could customize it to suit any business you like. The template is fully responsive so will look amazing on any screen. It’s SEO-friendly too!

Key features of the Dentalist template

  • Crisp, clean modern web template for healthcare professionals
  • Fully customizable with built-in tools
  • Readymade service and contact pages
  • SEO friendly and fully responsive
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: The Dentalist template, designed to create trust within the healthcare industry

item.title: Sports Equipment Store
item.content:encoded:
The Sports Equipment Store template is an energetic design that engages right away. It uses contrasting colors, lots of whitespace and strong images to create an amazing first impression. It’s everything you need to build an online store.

This fully responsive eCommerce template can promote a brick and mortar store, sell online or both. Compatible with drag and drop page builders and the WordPress editor, you can change everything you see on the page. It’s so easy to do!

Key features of the Sports Equipment Store template

  • Energetic eCommerce theme for sports stores
  • Well-balanced with lots of whitespace
  • Creates an amazing first impression
  • Fully customizable to fit your brand
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Sports Equipment Store template that engages immediately ready to sell

item.title: Aquarium
item.content:encoded:
The Aquarium is an awe-inspiring, beautifully crafted website template perfect for promoting an aquarium. The sea blue color template instantaneously sets the tone of a deep sea diving experience.

The template is perfect for showcasing your aquarium's daily schedule, booking a virtual guided tour, and showcasing all the sea animals on your website. Additionally, an impressive gallery page helps visitors understand the species on display at the aquarium.

Key features of the Aquarium template

  • Awe-inspiring design tailor-made for an aquarium
  • The package includes templates for highlighting the animal species, among other things
  • Include a virtual guided tour helping visitors visualize the aquarium from the comfort of their doorstep
  • Allow visitors to book tickets online through your website
  • The template looks great on all mobile devices as well
item.excerpt:encoded: Perfect template for showcasing aquatic plants and animals on an aquarium-based website

item.title: Faithful Gathering
item.content:encoded:
The Faithful Gathering Church template is an inclusive design that offers a warm welcome to everyone. It’s ideal for churches, community groups, faith groups and any type of organization.

The template can be fully customized using built-in tools or your favorite drag and drop page builder. You can change colors, fonts, layout, header, footer and everything you see on the page. It’s beginner-friendly, fully responsive and SEO friendly. It’s everything you need a web template to be.

Key features of the Faithful Gathering template

  • Welcoming web template for community groups
  • Fully customizable and user-friendly
  • Includes default pages and page elements
  • SEO friendly and fully responsive
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: The Faithful Gathering Church template is ready to welcome everyone

item.title: Security Services
item.content:encoded:
The Security Services template is a strong template with a bold blue background and stark white typography. It sets the scene perfectly, inspiring confidence and giving you the impression of security and professionalism.

The template delivers a complete website that installs in seconds and can be fully customized. You can change fonts, colors, images, content, layout and anything you like using the WordPress editor or your favorite page builder. It looks just as good on mobile too!

Key features of the Security Services template

  • Strong, confident security service template
  • Bold colors and design perfect for the industry
  • Great layout that would need minimal customization
  • Fast, SEO friendly and fully responsive
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Security Services template ideal for security, protection and corporate use

item.title: Financial Advisor
item.content:encoded:
The Financial Advisor template helps create trust immediately with sensible colors, calm typography and a layout that encourages engagement. There’s also a form in the hero section to immediately accept signups.

The readymade pages are designed for the financial industry but could be tweaked to suit any type of business. The template is fully compatible with popular page builders, allowing you to customize every aspect of the design, from the header to the footer. It’s also fully responsive and SEO friendly for the widest reach.

Key features of the Financial Advisors template

  • Well-designed web template for consultants and advisors
  • Smart layout with contact forms throughout
  • Builds authority and trust ideal for the niche
  • SEO friendly and fully responsive
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Financial Advisor template designed to create trust and interest

item.title: Furniture Haven
item.content:encoded:
The Furniture Haven template is an exceptional eCommerce template designed to appeal to the widest audience. While set up as a furniture store, the design is so good, you could sell anything with minimal effort.

If the default template doesn’t fit your brand, you can change everything from the header to the footer using built-in tools. The template is also compatible with popular page builders and the WordPress editor so you definitely have options!

Key features of the Furniture Haven template

  • Stylish eCommerce template with a contemporary feel
  • Could easily be tweaked to suit any type of store
  • Lots of space for images to showcase your products
  • SEO friendly and fully responsive
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: The Furniture Haven template is a new standard for eCommerce store design

item.title: John's Fitness Hub
item.content:encoded:
The John's Fitness Hub template is designed to portray the energy and enthusiasm of the industry to help attract new clients and help them change their lives. It uses vibrant colors and images to paint the picture of a healthy lifestyle.

While created for fitness, the template could easily be customized to suit any business. It is fully compatible with popular page builders and includes built-in tools to help you change everything you see on the page. The template is also fully responsive and SEO friendly so all bases are covered.

Key features of the John's Fitness Hub template

  • Vibrant web template for fitness and activity businesses
  • Uses lots of images and effects for engagement
  • Can be fully customized with built-in tools
  • SEO friendly and fully responsive
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: The Fitness Hub website template is designed to help you help others transform their lives

item.title: BBQ Restaurant
item.content:encoded:
The Restaurant BBQ template is an atmospheric web design that helps build an appetite for your food and your business. The bold dark design is softened by white typography and a bright contrast color and uses parallax scrolling to add a touch of style.

The default design could work well for BBQ joints, food trucks, restaurants and any type of food business. You can change everything you see on the page, from the header to the footer using built-in tools or popular builders.

Key features of the BBQ Restaurant template

  • Atmospheric template for food businesses
  • Nice layout with smooth flow down the page
  • Parallax scrolling makes the design stand out
  • SEO friendly and fully responsive
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: The Restaurant BBQ template helps create an appetite for your food business

item.title: Fashion Blogger
item.content:encoded:
The Fashion Blog template delivers the features you need to launch an engaging website where you can engage, share stories and discuss fashion and beauty. The design is stylish, attractive and can be fully customized to your taste using WordPress or your favorite page builder.

The Fashion Blog template looks professional and delivers the quality of design you expect from fashion. It’s the perfect partner to help you create an engaging blog that can help create authority in the fashion or beauty niche.

Key features of the Fashion Blogger template

  • Stylish design ideal for fashion and beauty
  • Smart blog layout with some nice touches
  • Everything can be customized
  • SEO friendly and fully responsive
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: The Fashion Blog template is a stylish design ideal for fashion and beauty

item.title: Flower Shop
item.content:encoded:
The Flower Shop template is a pro-quality eCommerce template that can promote your store and sell online at the same time. It is well-designed, flexible and fully customizable so you can tweak it to fit your brand using your favorite page builder or the WordPress editor.

The Flower Shop template is fast, easy to use and fully responsive. It will look amazing on any screen size while providing a smooth customer experience. It’s everything a florist or flower shop needs to thrive online.

Key features of the Flower Shop template

  • Welcome eCommerce template for florists and flower shops
  • Fully customizable design
  • Nice default layout with attractive product pages
  • Simple to install and set up
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: The Flower Shop template is ideal for budding florists and flower shops

item.title: Home Remodeling
item.content:encoded:
The Home Remodeling template is a contemporary design with simple colors and a largely grayscale layout. It combines gray areas with white fonts and white backgrounds to build an interesting layout that’s different from the norm.

It’s a very effective design with some great color choices, flexible content areas, an image gallery, testimonial section and calls to action. Supplementary pages reflect a similar design while enabling you to share what you do and how you do it.

Key features of the Home Remodeling template

  • Subtle colors keep everything low key but engaging
  • Interesting layout that keeps you interested
  • Flexible content areas to tell your story
  • Useful extra pages useful for the niche
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Interesting design business template that’s not afraid to be a little different

item.title: Cleaning Services
item.content:encoded:
The Cleaning Services template is instantly engaging thanks to a full screen image background and bright contrast color. Add bright white text and bright calls to action and you have a website design that’s going to convert.

The template mixes blue and pink seamlessly and even includes some smart hover effects for extra engagement. Colors can be changed, as can fonts, the layout and everything you see on every page. It’s a very flexible template!

Key features of the Cleaning Services template

  • Design makes an instant first impression
  • Good use of bold colors and images
  • Flexible content areas with hover effect
  • All the supplementary pages you could need
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Colorful web template that could work perfectly for cleaners and cleaning companies

item.title: Serenity Spa
item.content:encoded:
The Serenity Spa template adds a touch of class and serenity designed for spas, beauty and therapy. The template is modern with a dark background and contrasting fonts and buttons, with strong images to help tell your story.

You can change everything you see on the page, including colors, the background, typography, images and content using built-in tools or your favorite page builder. All the foundations are here to help you create a show stopping website for your spa, beaty or wellness business.

Key features of the Serenity Spa template

  • Serene design with strong elements
  • Inspires confidence with its professional appeal
  • Fully customizable using built-in tools
  • SEO friendly and fully responsive
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: The Serenity Spa template adds style and substance for spas and beauty businesses

item.title: Food and Drinks Blog
item.content:encoded:
The Food and Drinks Blog template has a great design that sets it apart from the usual. It opens with a full screen image with space for a headline and call to action before opening out into a traditional blog layout. This helps create a fantastic first impression.

The rest of the template uses a mix of fonts and a well-blended design that mixes the brand colors with minimal layout that lets the blog images shine. A smart sidebar with lots of widget spaces and a range of pre-made category pages completes the look.

Key features of the Food and Drinks Blog template

  • Full screen image makes an instant impact
  • Composed design combines color and minimalism
  • Overall design lets images shine
  • Sidebars have lots of space for widgets
  • Full compatibility with leading page builders
item.excerpt:encoded: Colorful responsive web template for food, drink, entertainment or leisure blogs
